title: Tiny, cute top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hatGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a4a9e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a2d6e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d94a7a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#4a3a85'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#6a5ab8'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <path d='M26 70 L30 26 Q50 20 70 26 L74 70 Z' fill='url(#hatGrad)'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='27' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#7a6ad0'/>
  <!-- pink band -->
  <path d='M27 58 L73 58 L73.5 66 L26.5 66 Z' fill='url(#bandGrad)'/>
  <!-- band shine -->
  <rect x='32' y='59' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffb3cf'/>
  <!-- crown shine -->
  <path d='M36 32 Q38 30 40 32 L40 54 Q38 56 36 54 Z' fill='#8a7ae0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- brim shine -->
  <path d='M20 69 Q30 65 40 69' stroke='#8a7ae0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
